nodes.label: MVP Cognitive Baseline (healthy → MCI)
nodes.rationale: Targets healthy elderly through Mild Cognitive Impairment; defers moderate/severe dementia to v2 to focus UX and game difficulty curves on the most addressable cohort and ship a faster, clinically credible MVP. Dementia-friendly modes warrant a separate phase.

nodes.label: Caregiver Dashboard on Flutter Web (shared models)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard built as Flutter Web reusing shared Dart models from the mobile app — a single Dart codebase eliminates model-sync bugs and avoids a separate React team; responsive for ASHA workers on tablets in the field.

nodes.label: Offline-First Gaming + Sync Queue Architecture
nodes.rationale: Games fully playable offline; mobile stores sessions/reminders in local SQLite (drift) SyncQueue, background service polls every 30s and replays to an idempotent /sync endpoint on reconnect. NER connectivity is spotty so offline is non-negotiable; conflict-free for MVP (offline sessions are fresh inserts).

nodes.label: Voice Companion (Bhashini + Claude)
nodes.rationale: ASR (patient's local language via Bhashini) → Claude (English reasoning) → TTS (local language). LanguageServiceProvider abstracts Bhashini for pluggability; system prompt DB-versioned so persona updates need no code change. Voice is essential to include low-literacy elderly.

nodes.label: Reminder Escalation Thresholds
nodes.rationale: 10 min unacknowledged → secondary re-prompt; 3 missed same-type reminders in 7 days → AlertFlag to family + ASHA. Thresholds catch medication non-compliance early without over-prompting or false alarms; evaluated by an APScheduler job over ReminderEvent history.

nodes.label: Multilingual MVP Scope (NER languages)
nodes.rationale: Ship Assamese, Bengali, Hindi, English (highest NER coverage). Further languages (Manipuri/Meitei, Khasi, Mizo, Nepali, Bodo) added config-only as Bhashini pipeline IDs with no code changes; responses accept a ?language= param, preferred_language stored per user.

nodes.label: JWT Auth + Role-Based Access Control
nodes.rationale: JWT access (15 min) + refresh (7 days), server-side role enforcement across 5 roles (patient, family_caregiver, asha_worker, clinician, admin). Refresh enables low-connectivity re-login. No implicit caregiver access — each caregiver-to-patient access needs an active CaregiverPatientLink + ConsentRecord and is audited.

nodes.label: DPDP Act 2023 Compliance
nodes.rationale: DPDP Act 2023 as a first-class feature, not a layer: explicit consent scopes (game_data/health_data/voice_companion) with patient_self/guardian/joint types, immutable AuditLog, AES-256 column encryption at rest, purpose-limitation enforcement, and retention policy with soft-delete + 30-day-grace hard-delete on revocation.

hyperedges.label: Offline-first gaming architecture (brainstorm → decision → games engine)
Claude + Bhashini AI language layer (voice companion, multilingual, RAG share the LLM stack)
